basic_info.description: The compelling charm of this 1907 home lies in the artful interpretation of its romantic interior architecture, stunning city views, & airy, indoor/outdoor connectivity. The 2 story, 3 bedroom home includes a one bedroom, in-law apartment, occupied by long-term tenants. The best-kept-secret block gives way to a luminous, modernized, residence whose floorplan is organized to take in panoramic views of San Francisco. A generous living room, anchored by a kiva-like fireplace + library, & the luminous formal dining room flow to the city view deck. The professionally-equipped kitchen includes, handsome tile-clad backsplash, quartz counters, extensive storage & a cosy media lounge accessing the deck. A sheltered garden below is lush with mature landscaping, flowering shrubs, tree ferns & orchids.  A fresh, sky-lit marble bath completes this level. A skylit stair leads to 3 bedrooms, used as 2 beds + office/lounge. The Bauhaus-inspired bath is a striking, sky-lit space, the walk-in shower open the sky. The primary bedroom is projected into the views from a private deck overlooking Eureka Valley & Downtown. 1 car garage.  This unique, bespoke residence, Legally 2-Units is subject to tenants rights. Walk to coffee, parks - city culture abounds!
